decisionsTitle: «Contact direct» above the form, which gets its own heading; the feedback form says «alergare», not «eveniment» (amending §461, §680, §689 and the sections decision of the same day)
changelogLine: - **«Contact direct» first** — the club's address and phone now stand above the contact form, which gets its own heading, «Trimite-ne un mesaj»; and «Spune-ne ceva» says «alergare» where it said «eveniment». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: On the contact page «Contact direct» / "Reach us directly" stands under the intro and above the form, in every state that has an address or a phone, the address left out only while a delivery error's alert names it. The form is a section headed «Trimite-ne un mesaj» / "Send us a message", with a rule above it under «Contact direct» and a heading only while the form is drawn. This amends the sections criterion of the same day (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The Romanian feedback form names the event picker «Alergarea» and says «Nicio alergare găsită». Its door and its hints speak of «o alergare», not «un eveniment», and the chip «Evenimente speciale» keeps its words (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Contact direct» above the form; «alergare» in «Spune-ne ceva»
